case.summary: Transaction 3526826 ($35.66, online) on card C07671-K2 was alerted due to an uncalibrated legacy risk score of 0.76. In contrast, the calibrated second-generation fraud model assigned a very low score of 0.006, indicating an empirical historical fraud likelihood of 0.6%. The transaction utilized device D008387, a generic non-proxy Windows Chrome profile shared across 266 cards with zero fraud ring links and no confirmed fraud cases. Although card C07671-K2 had historical fraud cases earlier in the year, the specific cardholder identity has no compromised history, and card activity shows continuous normal spending without testing sequences or velocity spikes. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity.
